name: prepare_document_tools
description: Check or prepare the local Python-backed document tools used by the Office skills. Use this before DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, or PDF creation/editing when dependencies may be missing. The prepare action creates or updates the app-managed Python environment and installs required Python packages. Do not request optional tools unless the user explicitly confirms after you explain that LibreOffice/Poppler may download or install large binaries.

action.description: Use check to report current readiness. Use prepare to install or update required document-tool dependencies.

include_optional_tools.description: Backward-compatible shortcut. When true, prepare both optional LibreOffice and Poppler helpers. Ask the user first; LibreOffice can be hundreds of MB.

optional_tools.description: Selective optional helpers to prepare after explicit user confirmation. Use poppler for PDF/page image rendering. Use libreoffice for Office-to-PDF conversion, visual QA, and Excel recalculation; it can be a large download.
